recent_posts.title: Deploying Claude across financial services
recent_posts.summary: Anthropic has published a deployment guide for financial services firms using Claude. It covers the full product lineup including Claude Chat, Cowork, Code, Microsoft 365 add-ins, the Claude Platform, and Claude Managed Agents. The guide includes 10 pre-built finance agent templates (pitch builders, KYC screeners, GL reconcilers, etc.), customer stories from AIG, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, IG Group, and Moody's, and a three-phase adoption playbook (foundation, pilot, scale) targeting AI leaders and engineers rolling out Claude within financial institutions.

recent_posts.title: How a non-technical project manager built and shipped a stress management app with Claude Code in six weeks
recent_posts.summary: Kostiantyn Vlasenko, a non-technical project manager at Mythical Games, built and shipped Respiro — an iOS stress management app with real-time stress detection and guided breathing exercises — using Claude Code with zero prior coding experience. In roughly six weeks (72 hours of active building), he created a multi-agent architecture with 15+ specialized subagents, rewrote the app from React Native to Swift, navigated the Apple Developer Program, and set up analytics and marketing — all guided by Claude. The app is now live on the App Store with hundreds of users. Vlasenko credits his project management background for making agent orchestration feel natural, and has since introduced his Claude workflows to the engineering team at his day job.

recent_posts.title: Building AI agents for the enterprise
recent_posts.summary: Anthropic has published a guide on enterprise AI transformation focused on deploying agentic AI at scale. It covers three pillars of enterprise AI adoption, strategies for overcoming the 'agentic thinking divide,' employee upskilling, compressing information-dense processes, and building revenue-generating product capabilities. The guide includes case studies from L'Oreal, Lyft, and Rakuten, plus a six-month deployment framework for Claude Cowork, Anthropic's enterprise offering that brings agentic AI to teams without requiring custom builds.

recent_posts.title: Claude Security is now in public beta
recent_posts.summary: Claude Security is now in public beta for Claude Enterprise customers. Powered by Claude Opus 4.7, it scans codebases for vulnerabilities, traces data flows across files and modules, and generates targeted patches — without requiring API integration or custom agent builds. Key features include scheduled scans, multi-stage validation to reduce false positives, confidence ratings per finding, and integrations with Slack, Jira, CSV/Markdown export, and webhooks. Major security vendors including CrowdStrike, Microsoft Security, Palo Alto Networks, SentinelOne, and Wiz are embedding Opus 4.7 into their platforms. The release reflects lessons from a two-month limited preview with hundreds of enterprises, focusing on detection quality, fast scan-to-fix cycles, and ongoing coverage rather than one-off audits.

recent_posts.title: New guide Deploying Claude across the enterprise with Claude Cowork
recent_posts.summary: Anthropic has published a deployment guide for Claude Cowork, a desktop AI tool that extends Claude's agent capabilities beyond developers to all enterprise workers — analysts, lawyers, marketers, and more. The guide covers a five-level adoption maturity model, how to structure a pilot, a six-month rollout roadmap, and real-world use cases from Anthropic's own finance, legal, sales, and product teams, as well as customers like Thomson Reuters, Zapier, and Jamf. Claude Cowork integrates with local files, Slack, Google Drive, the browser, Excel, and PowerPoint, and supports plugins and custom commands.

recent_posts.title: Claude API skill now in CodeRabbit, JetBrains, Resolve AI, and Warp
recent_posts.summary: Anthropic's claude-api skill, first introduced in Claude Code in March, is now bundled in CodeRabbit, JetBrains (including Junie), Resolve AI, and Warp. The skill provides production-ready Claude API code generation with built-in knowledge of agent patterns, prompt caching, context compaction, and model migration. It stays current as Anthropic's SDKs evolve. Developers can ask Claude to improve cache hit rates, add context compaction to agents, upgrade to the latest model, or build deep research agents using Claude Managed Agents. The skill is open source and any coding agent can bundle it via a ~20-line CI setup.

recent_posts.title: Product development in the agentic era
recent_posts.summary: Jess Yan, a product manager at Anthropic working on Claude Managed Agents, shares how she uses Claude and Claude Code to transform her PM workflow. She describes using Claude for open-ended research, Claude Code to rapidly prototype agents against pre-production APIs, and Managed Agents to automate operational tasks like adoption analytics, developer sentiment monitoring, and demo building. The post argues that AI agents free PMs from administrative overhead, enabling more time for creative product work and direct user engagement.

recent_posts.title: Onboarding Claude Code like a new developer: Lessons from 17 years of development
recent_posts.summary: Brendan MacLean, principal developer of Skyline (a 700,000-line C# open source protein analysis tool), shares how he applied his 17-year developer onboarding methodology to Claude Code. By maintaining a dedicated AI context repository (pwiz-ai), building reusable 'skills' that encode domain knowledge, and integrating MCP servers for real data access, he transformed how his lab handles legacy code. Key outcomes include completing a year-long abandoned feature in two weeks, automating screenshot reproduction for 2,000+ tutorial images, and enabling developers to ship new features they previously felt too buried to attempt. Core advice: treat context as a versioned project artifact, build a skill library for domain knowledge, and use MCP integrations where data access matters.

top_posts.title: How Anthropic uses Claude in Marketing
top_posts.summary: A non-technical growth marketer at Anthropic used Claude Code to build custom automation workflows that reduced ad creation time from 30 minutes to 30 seconds. Starting with zero coding experience, he created a Figma plugin for generating ad variations and a Google Ads copy workflow with CSV export. The article details his process, best practices for non-technical users building with AI coding tools, and examples of how other marketing teams at Anthropic are using Claude to save hundreds of hours monthly on repetitive tasks.

top_posts.title: Improving skill-creator: Test, measure, and refine Agent Skills
top_posts.summary: Anthropic has enhanced skill-creator, a tool for building Agent Skills in Claude, with testing and evaluation capabilities. Authors can now write evals to verify skill behavior, run benchmarks tracking pass rate, time, and token usage, and use multi-agent support to run evals in parallel without context bleed. A comparator agent enables A/B testing between skill versions. The update also adds description tuning to improve skill triggering accuracy, reducing false positives and negatives. Two skill types are distinguished: capability uplift skills (teaching Claude new behaviors) and encoded preference skills (sequencing existing capabilities per team workflows), each benefiting from evals differently. The framework is available on Claude.ai, Cowork, and as a Claude Code plugin.

top_posts.title: Making Claude a better electrical engineer
top_posts.summary: Anthropic partnered with Diode Computers to improve Claude's ability to auto-generate electrical circuit board reference designs from chip documentation. The collaboration focused on teaching Claude to work with Zener, a domain-specific language for PCB schematics, and to interpret dense technical documentation. Claude Sonnet 4.5 now produces reference designs preferred by electrical engineers 8 out of 10 times compared to earlier versions, better capturing documentation nuances and following toolchain conventions. This demonstrates how domain experts can collaborate with Anthropic to enhance Claude's performance on specialized technical tasks.

top_posts.title: Claude Enterprise, now available self-serve
top_posts.summary: Claude Enterprise is now available for self-serve purchase with a seat-plus-usage pricing model. The offering provides organization-wide access to Claude, Claude Code, and Cowork with enterprise security features including SSO, SCIM provisioning, audit logs, custom data retention policies, and usage analytics. It integrates with Microsoft 365, Slack, Excel, and PowerPoint through connectors and built-in chat sidebars. Organizations use it across sales, engineering, marketing, product, and finance teams to accelerate workflows and handle complex tasks with large codebases and document sets.

top_posts.title: Redesigning Claude Code on desktop for parallel agents
top_posts.summary: Anthropic has redesigned the Claude Code desktop app to support parallel agentic workflows. Key additions include a new sidebar for managing multiple concurrent sessions across repos, drag-and-drop workspace layout, an integrated terminal and file editor, a faster diff viewer, expanded preview support for HTML and PDFs, and SSH support extended to Mac. Three view modes (Verbose, Normal, Summary) let users control how much detail they see. The app now streams responses in real time and has parity with CLI plugins. Available to Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plan users and via the Claude API.
